title: scoring.js is pure shared — runs identically client and server
detail: scoreResults, applyConfidenceGate, hasContentMatch, meaningfulTerms, normalizeForMatch are all imported by both hooks.useSearch (client) and api/search.js (server). No divergence — both paths use the same code. Maintain this: do not fork scoring logic into per-side copies.

title: lib.rrf is pure shared — already used both client (3-input) and server (2-input)
detail: api/search.js imports buildNativeRanks, nativeWeight, rrfScores from lib/rrf.js and uses a two-input fusion (native + lexical) at lines 349-364. hooks.useSemanticRerank uses a three-input fusion (native + lexical + semantic) at lines 111-115. The semantic arm is the only difference and is unavailable server-side (Web Worker constraint). Both paths are correctly converged on RRF. No further work needed on the sharing front.

title: Semantic rerank is inherently client-only — document the capability gap for API consumers
detail: computeSemanticRanks uses the Web Worker API, which is unavailable in Vercel serverless Functions. The ~23MB MiniLM model also cannot be loaded synchronously in a serverless cold-start context. This is an accepted architectural constraint. No server reuse is possible without a separate embedding microservice. Document clearly in API docs: the /api/search endpoint does not apply semantic reranking.

title: lib.dedup is pure shared — already used both client and server
detail: Both dedupFirstWins (streaming / client) and dedupHighestScore (pooled / server) are imported and used on their respective sides. lib.groupResults (book-chapter clustering) is client-render-only and correctly has no server use. Keep the existing split.

title: lib.goldSetMetrics is NOT orphaned — used by GoldSetHarness admin component
detail: goldSetMetrics is imported by src/components/admin/GoldSetHarness.jsx (F2 admin console feature). It is not orphaned. The regression harness is admin-gated (only visible to the email allowlist). Unit tests live in goldSetMetrics.test.js and are the only test file in the lib/ directory — they cover nDCG, MRR, recall, computeMetrics, aggregateMetrics with deterministic fixtures.
